biography:
Over fifteen years of experience in developing and leading high performing matrix teams with technical expertise to find creative solutions.  Proven track record for execution of high-profile, complex projects in an ever-changing, fast-paced environment, from $200 million utility projects to $2 billion data centers, driving large, multi-faceted organizations with regular executive-level communication.  Passions include leading people and programs to think more creatively, inspiring change (including more women in leadership, construction, and STEM fields), and driving successful programs in diverse environments.

Accomplishments:
- Driving data center development from site selection to construction breakground
- Leading utility work for Caltrain Electrification Project: transmission interconnection and gas and electric line relocations
- Developing a creative solution to protect the endangered Shasta Crayfish while continuing hydropower operations

Passions: advancing women in STEM and construction fields, environmental restoration, SCUBA diving, underwater photography, cycling, mountain biking, hiking, rafting, kayaking, and outrigger canoeing.

Specialties: Data Center Development, Strategic Initiatives, Program Delivery, Contract Negotiations, Advanced Project Management Certification, Infrastructure, Electric Distribution and Transmission, Gas Distribution and Transmission, Telecom Fiber, Environmental Permitting and Clearance Strategy.
